软件更新强制执行 (Software Update Enforcement)

Enterprise MDM marketing uses 软件更新强制执行 when describing fleet policies that require managed devices to install a target OS version or build — especially when paired with compliance deadlines and force-install workflows. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — a policy dashboard needs 软件更新强制执行-friendly headlines; a benefit line may use 强制系统更新 when accurate to your English source.

强制系统更新 vs 强制安装

US pages say "Force OS update" or "Force install by deadline." China storefront copy often uses 强制系统更新 for full OS version enforcement and 强制安装 when emphasizing install action after TargetLocalDateTime — distinct from 快速安全响应 RSR micro-patch vocabulary.

延迟更新 / 更新推迟 (deferral windows)

MDM deferral windows (typically 1–90 days) before users see new updates map to 延迟更新 or 更新推迟 on admin-console frames — not consumer "remind me later" copy alone. AppLocale aligns with whether your gallery shows IT-admin deferral sliders or end-user deferral UX.

Minimum OS version policy prevents managed devices below a floor from accessing org resources — 最低系统版本 on compliance dashboards. Do not conflate with app-level minimum-version strings in the binary unless your English source genuinely markets fleet minimum OS as lead.
